# Sentence Engine — LLM-free sentence generation (SQL-only)

**What this is.** The engine bundle behind Metatake's **Embedding Fantasia** layer: publishable English sentences about any film generated by **sentence templates + Postgres `format()` only — zero LLM calls**. Purpose: make explicit, as sentences, what no one could know without querying our DB — the hidden connections between films — entirely rule-based, ~$0, deterministic.

**Status: COMPLETE — data layer + all surfaces SHIPPED (2026-07-11).** `film_sentences` = **466,974 rows · 13 patterns · 6,713 films (96%)** + kin index (`film_kinship`) + fanout stats, rendered sitewide as **"Embedding Fantasia"**: film/director/theorist/trope/figure/lineage/genre modules · home+/room ticker · /map lexicon rail · kin-weighted graph edges · N_question hooks.

> **⭐ 세션 시작점은 이 폴더가 아니라 루트 `HANDOFF-임베딩판타지아-문장층.md` (정본 인수인계).**
> 자산·RPC·표면 지도·불변식(브랜드 계약 포함)·함정 장부·인제스트 접점(RUNBOOK Stage 18)·종결 장부(concept/frame 불가·/take obsolete)가 전부 거기 있다. 이 폴더는 **엔진 상세**(재생성 SQL·문장 템플릿·설계 역사)만 담는다.

## Quick facts (details in the HANDOFF)
- **13 patterns**: A_affinity · B_bridge · C_reading · D_award · E_rank · F_compare · G_theorist_twin · H_dense · I_lens_twin · J_location · L_trope · M_frame · N_question.
- **Invariants**: LLM 0 · `random()` 0(md5 시간시드 결정론) · 제목 선두 · `takes.status='published'` 게이트 · 링크는 `lib/urls` · **브랜드 계약(설계자 명기 + Not-AI 디스클레이머) 제거 금지**.
- **DB**: kyniq prod `jvgarcqrtsmgfimdcwgo` (Tokyo). Migrations `supabase/migrations/0061~0069`.
- **Refresh** (new films, idempotent): node stats → concept stats → kinship → 13 pattern INSERTs (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`). RUNBOOK-new-film-ingestion.md **Stage 18**.
